aborts_before_this_one.cause: reserved CFR title carries no edition date

disposition.cause: frozen transport budget incompatible with observed Wikimedia rate behavior

frozen_bounds_that_were_not_edited.why_not_edited: the three earlier SFIR4 corrections were unconditional defects with one right answer whichever way the census came out. This is a tuning parameter, and a value chosen after watching a run fail is chosen partly by the failure. Editing it would have been the first correction in this study to fail the standard the paper's own section 2 sets.

observed_rate_behaviour.shape: quota per ~60s window, not a per-request rate
observed_rate_behaviour.why_this_is_admissible_for_designing_a_s: it measures the ENDPOINT, not SFIR4's or SFIR5's capacity result. No candidate was counted, no threshold evaluated, no cohort read. Using it to choose a pacing budget is therefore not choosing a parameter by looking at an outcome.

result_blind_at_stop.how_verified: the destination path was checked for a receipt and the captured run output was searched for any capacity quantity; it holds a traceback and nothing else.

what_this_receipt_does_not_say: that SFIR4 measured anything. The criterion was never applied, so this is not a FAIL of the capacity threshold and must not be read as evidence that the declared frame is short of capacity. Nothing here establishes that either way.
